capital_reset: Each period starts from cash; no subsequent capital flows. Report maximum realized NAV because capital compounds.

liquidity_inputs.adv20: Mean daily turnover in CNY over previous 20 market sessions, minimum 20 known observations, shifted one session.
liquidity_inputs.sigma20: Sample standard deviation of adjusted daily simple returns over previous 20 market sessions, minimum 20 known observations, shifted one session.
liquidity_inputs.zero_turnover: Only evidenced full-session suspension may map missing daily amount to zero; other unknown inputs remain missing.
liquidity_inputs.zero_or_unknown_adv: No constrained fill; retry later and report reason.
liquidity_inputs.vwap: daily amount (thousand CNY) * 1000 / (daily vol in lots * 100), checked against unadjusted low and high

capacity_formula: For each stock/date share one buy-plus-sell monetary budget min(participation * lag_ADV20, participation * realized_daily_amount); realized day amount affects fills only, not selection or pre-close intent.
incremental_impact: Extra cash cost C(Q)=eta * lag_sigma20 * Q * sqrt(Q / lag_ADV20), using cumulative same-stock/date notional; charge only C(Q_after)-C(Q_before). No simultaneous price adjustment.
impact_interpretation: Uncalibrated additional liquidity deterioration above the original 30bp and minimum commission, not an estimate of true total transaction cost. Coefficients are fixed sensitivity assumptions.
budget: Prior-close cash only; plan at known upper limit with worst-case impact allowance, integer buy lots. Current sale proceeds cannot fund current purchases.
partial_fills: Carry ordinary target deficits and risk exit residuals; maintain one replacement slot per risk event, including later sale receipts and partially filled replacement orders. Month-end retargeting is explicitly recorded.
completion_metric: Daily order-attempt amount completion: sum(filled_units * prior_close_mark) / sum(planned_units * prior_close_mark). Retries re-enter denominator. Not unique parent-order completion.
limits: Daily aggregate fills at whole-day VWAP are a separate execution scenario, not certification of opening-auction or intraday fillability.
No queue, spread, minute path, endogenous volume response, or empirically fitted impact coefficient.
Daily suspension and eligibility filters are conservative and can differ from original opening-only eligibility.
Adjusted units and synthetic distribution reinvestment retain the original wealth-accounting limitations.
2024-2025 is already inspected historical holdout; scenarios do not create a new independent validation sample.
No threshold is selected after viewing outcomes; there is no guaranteed capacity recommendation.
matched_volatility_control: CAP_1P_SIGMA has zero extra impact but the same known-sigma requirement as MAIN_1P; separates input coverage from extra impact and path effects. Added after input coverage audit, before scenario outcomes.
